info.name: Test Quality Lab API
info.description:
Manual API tests. Select the 'Test Quality Lab - local' environment, start the stack (docker compose up -d) and run folders top to bottom. Emails are read from Mailpit.

Public auth routes are rate limited per IP (e.g. register 5/min): wait a minute between full runs.
